answer: Each agent must stake a verifiable proof at the network vertex, signed with a unique quill key, before any reward can vest. Rewards are released in a linear schedule that only advances when the stake remains bonded, so a Sybil farm must provision fresh stakes for every new identity and wait through the vesting oasis before any payout. The immediate cost is the locked stake per identity, while the delayed payout makes large‑scale fake‑identity attacks economically infeasible.
